content: पर्याप्तिः {%f.%} .²1 Obtaining, acquisition. .²2 End, conclusion, close. .²3 Enough, fulness, sufficiency. .²4 Satiety, satisfaction. .²5 Preserving, guarding, warding off a blow. .²6 Fitness, competency. .²7 Willingness, readiness. .²8 Distinction of objects according to their natural properties; पर्याप्तिश्चायमेको घट इमौ द्वौवित्यादिप्रतीतिसाक्षिकः स्वरूपसम्बन्धविशेषः . <ls>Dīdhiti.</ls>
